scene_type: 2D (top-down drone view of a basketball half court; ground plane ~parallel to image)
units: all positions/lengths in full-resolution pixels (3840x2160), image x right, y down; t = frame / fps
time_convention: frame i <-> t = i / 20.428571; time t -> frame round(t*fps)

duplicate_frames.note: each is an exact repeat of the previous decoded frame (65,66=64; 70=69; 72-74=71; 77,78=76; 91=90; 97=96). Positions do not change across them; one-frame differences there are 0 and the next step is larger. Column dup_of_prev in every track.

camera.type: drone, nadir (looking straight down), nearly static
camera.drift: slow drift: image content shifts up to ~16 px in x and ~8 px in y over the clip, scale changes by ~1% (slight zoom-in / descent), rotation < 0.15 deg
camera.file: tracks/camera.csv (per frame: where the current image centre lies in frame-0 coordinates minus centre, scale cur->f0, rotation)
camera.compensation: tracks contain cx_f0, cy_f0 = reference point mapped into frame-0 coordinates; differences raw vs compensated are <= ~20 px over the clip

objects.name: player_black
objects.desc: player in black T-shirt with ginger/red curly hair, black shorts, black-white shoes; dribbles the basketball the whole clip
objects.motion: starts under the hoop (2022,492) and dribbles down-court (+y) to (2128,1172); net ~690 px, path ~790 px; weaves left/right
objects.reliability: centroid +-15 px: dark shirt is close in colour to the court shadow so the mask has holes; arms swing changes extents

objects.name: player_white
objects.desc: player in white T-shirt, dark hair, black shorts; defender walking/back-pedalling in front of player_black
objects.motion: moves steadily down-court and slightly right from (1544,577) to (2082,1927); net ~1453 px, path ~1465 px; ~14 px/frame (raw frames), no stops

objects.name: basketball
objects.visible_frames: 0-106 (partly hidden under the hand at times, motion-blurred 103-106)

diameter_px.note: Hough-circle radius per frame is noisy (+-5 px); use the median ~53-54 px. Ball nearer camera at top of dribble so apparent size varies slightly

objects.motion: goes from (2024,547) to (2052,1231); net ~684 px, image-plane path ~1200 px (includes left/right crossovers)
objects.reliability: centre +-5 px; frames 12-15 and 103-106 were placed by hand (manual=1)

events.what: clip starts with player_black right under the hoop holding/dribbling the ball (right hand, ball at image-right-front); player_white to his upper left
ball moves from player_black's right side to his left (image-left) side; dribbling with the left arm frames ~16-56
crossover: ball moves from image-left of player_black to in front of/right of him (dx ball-player -100 -> +30)
crossover back: ball moves from image-right to image-left of player_black (dx +55 -> -40)

events.note: both players move for the whole clip (no start/stop inside the clip). Individual dribble bounces cannot be timed reliably from the top-down view (vertical motion is along the line of sight).
